title: On Overcoming the loss of the whole crop
subtitle: 困难与应对 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 困难与应对（做人与做事·困难与应对）
meta: 主题语境：困难与应对（做人与做事·困难与应对）　|　核心词汇：overcome　|　正文 356 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 overcome 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1966 the elder ① overcomed the loss of the whole crop without a word of thanks, and every youth in the village said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three years on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the elder ② overcomes the loss of the whole crop at once without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ overcome the loss of the whole crop at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ overcomed the loss of the whole crop before — a line in the memoir for November 1960 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Overcoming the loss of the whole crop without a word of thanks, the elder said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the staff at the far gate, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ overcome the strongest swimmer at once, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Overcome the strongest swimmer at once and never mention it again.

By 1973 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the memoir, and a new youth from the next village ⑧ overcomes the strongest swimmer without a word of thanks every year without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the gate, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ overcomed the loss of the whole crop again when nobody else would.

⑩ To overcome the loss of the whole crop, my mother said in 1978, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the village remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the village forgets, somebody overcomes the loss of the whole crop at once again and somebody must overcome the loss of the whole crop without a word of thanks all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 克服（一般过去式 overcomed the loss of the whole crop：1966 年长者头一回这样做，不图一句谢）
B. v. 克服（一般现在 overcomes the loss of the whole crop：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 克服（不定式 to overcome the loss of the whole crop：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 克服（过去完成时 had overcomed the loss of the whole crop：1960 年十一月的回忆录上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 克服（动名词 overcoming the loss of the whole crop 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 压倒（overcome the strongest swimmer：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去压倒把最强壮的游泳者也压倒了）
G. v. 压倒（overcome the strongest swimmer：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 克服（后段两处：新来的后生照例 overcomes the strongest swimmer，而母亲又一次 overcomed the loss of the whole crop）

answers.why: overcome 意为“克服”，1966 年长者不图一句谢克服挺过整季庄稼的损失，那是村子里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 overcomed。
overcome 意为“克服”，自那以后长者二话不说地把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 overcomes。
overcome 意为“克服”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯克服挺过整季庄稼的损失”，此处为不定式 to overcome the loss of the whole crop。
overcome 意为“克服”，回忆录里 十一月 那行字说明早在 1973 年之前就有人克服过，故用过去完成时 had overcomed。
overcome 意为“克服”，长者说“克服挺过整季庄稼的损失这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 overcoming the loss of the whole crop 作主语。
overcome 意为“压倒”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去压倒把最强壮的游泳者也压倒了”，should ever 之后用原形 overcome the strongest swimmer。
overcome 意为“压倒”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻压倒把最强壮的游泳者也压倒了（overcome the strongest swimmer at once），以后再也不要提起。
overcome 意为“克服”，新来的后生每个年头都照例压倒把最强壮的游泳者也压倒了，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 overcomes。
overcome 意为“克服”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次不图一句谢克服挺过整季庄稼的损失，用一般过去式 overcomed 叙述。
overcome 意为“克服”，结尾那句是母亲 1978 年的话：要克服挺过整季庄稼的损失，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和村子记住的那一件。

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 overcome 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1966 the elder overcomed the loss of the whole crop without a word of thanks, and nobody in the village forgot it.
Even now the elder overcomes the loss of the whole crop at once whenever the village asks.
Overcoming the loss of the whole crop without a word of thanks, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever overcome the strongest swimmer at once, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new youth from the next village overcomes the strongest swimmer without a word of thanks every year, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother overcomed the loss of the whole crop again, and the village remembered that half.
